children: M&T Bank posted an investor presentation highlighting strong 1H26 results, improved asset quality and its 2026 financial outlook.
Reported 1H26 net income $1,482MM and diluted EPS $9.44, up 25% YoY—signals earnings momentum.
Strong loan growth: average loans up 3% from 4Q25 with non-CRE loans +6% in 2024–2025 and CRE inflection in 2Q26.
Asset quality improved: nonaccrual loans down 44% and criticized commercial loans down 53% since 2023.
2026 outlook: NII $7.2–7.35B (bottom half expected), fee income $2.8–2.85B (high end), expenses $5.5–5.6B.
Capital guidance: CET1 ratio expected 10.0%–10.5% for 2026; stress test implies SCB reduction to 2.5% minimum.
